meta_description: The Geneva Solution Space: a 330 m² ground-floor space and Fab Lab at Campus Biotech Innovation Park, Geneva. Photos, location, what you can host, prices and booking.

hero.title: 330 m² in International Geneva,
hero.lede: A flexible ground-floor space and a Fab Lab at Campus Biotech Innovation Park, run by the University of Geneva — for classes, workshops, hackathons, conferences and community events.

photos.alt: Groups working at tables during a workshop
The ground-floor space set up with tables

items.text: A 40 m² kitchen for coffee breaks, catering and apéros after your event.
A small, quiet room for calls and hybrid meetings during your event.

activities.title: What you can
activities.lede: The space is used every week by University of Geneva classes, international organizations, NGOs and student groups. Some of the formats it works well for:

items.title: Classes & workshops
items.text: Master's courses, block seminars, trainings and hands-on workshops in small teams.

items.title: Hackathons
items.text: Day-long or weekend sprints, with room for teams to spread out and the Fab Lab next door.

items.title: Conferences & panels
items.text: Talks, book launches, side events and round tables, in person or hybrid.

items.title: Networking & apéros
items.text: Community evenings, launches and receptions, with the kitchen for catering.

items.title: Retreats & strategy days
items.text: Team retreats, planning sessions and board meetings away from the office.

items.title: Prototyping
items.text: Build and test ideas in the Fab Lab: laser cutting, 3D printing, CNC and vinyl.

prices.title: Prices
paragraphs: The same rates apply to the ground floor and the Fab Lab. First-time users get half price on their first day.
If you are organising a University of Geneva (UNIGE) event with external funding or sponsorship, we would greatly appreciate a contribution towards the use of the space.

location.title: Where
location.text: Campus Biotech Innovation Park, 15 avenue de Sécheron, Geneva — a block from the WMO and the WTO, a 10-minute walk from the Palais des Nations and 10 minutes from Cornavin by tram 15.
location.alt: Aerial map of International Geneva pinning the Geneva Solution Space next to the WMO, WTO and UNHCR

band.title: Ready to
band.text: Pick a date on the calendar, choose your hours and send a request. We usually reply within two working days.
